_doc: Schema for site-pack/topology/fiber-map.json — cp to topology/fiber-map.json and replace the fictional entries. edge_routers = your internet edge router(s) (the last 10.x hop before the first public hop in a traceroute); rds2216_subnet = the optional LibreQoS/CGNAT hop that sits between the fiber router and the edge (skip it when walking back); networks = one entry per fiber network: the fiber router's name and IP as it appears in traceroutes and the edge it reaches. Used as a static fallback when the ticket's Network/Fiber field is missing; live discovery (traceroute walk) is preferred. All values below are fictional.
